per_candidate.id: s2:Stellar rotation effects on the stellar winds
s2:Energy Input of EUV, Solar Wind, and SEPs at Mars: MAVEN Observations During Sol

rationale: Paper 2404.14980 provides evidence on the challenges of constraining stellar winds by discussing the difficulty of observing them and presenting a method to estimate mass loss rates through X-ray detection of astrospheres. This contributes substantive new evidence on part of the question.
